blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Public hospitals across Surigao del Sur are straining due to patient surge, with the main provincial referral hospital reaching nearly double its bed capacity and major district facilities also overflowing. In a public advisory on Monday, the Adela Serra Ty Memorial Medical Center (ASTMMC) in Tandag City announced that its bed occupancy rate has surged to 195 percent of its regular capacity, warning the public to brace for longer waiting times, admission delays, and tight bed availability.
